data.body:
Fixes bug B708761957b: services.review._chat_command snapshots git_state(os.getcwd()) before/after the reviewer runs. When ddflow runs from a checkout other than the reviewed repo (and in ~17 tests under tests/ with kind=command fakes, which run in the real checkout), any commit or stash by another lane (stash list is shared) makes the review unavailable: 'the reviewer tool changed git state'. Fix the guard to watch the repo being reviewed; and give tests/conftest.py an autouse chdir into the repo fixture. B77b32b1bdb fixed only tests/test_review_triage_gate.py.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B708761957b --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B708761957b --regression-test <test>` first).

data.summary: For B77b32b1bdb the fix is a fixture inside tests/test_review_triage_gate.py; the verifier runs the named test on 'the base with the test file', which already carries the fix, so it passes and complete refuses; only --skip-regression-verify remains. Need a way to verify against the pre-fix version of the test file (or conftest) itself for test-infrastructure fixes.
